description: Search for Zendesk views by their title. Use when you need to find views in your Zendesk account by searching for keywords in their titles. Views are saved searches that display tickets matching specific conditions. This action supports filtering by access level, active status, group, and sorting results.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for searching Zendesk views.

access.description: Filter views by access level. Valid values are 'personal', 'shared', or 'account'. When not specified, returns views of all access levels.
access.human_parameter_description: Filter views by who can access them: personal (only you), shared (team), or account (everyone).
access.title: Access

active.description: Filter views by active status. Set to true to return only active views, or false to return only inactive views. When not specified, returns both active and inactive views.
active.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to show only active views, only inactive ones, or both.
active.title: Active

group_id.description: Filter views by group ID. Only returns views that are assigned to the specified group.
group_id.human_parameter_description: Enter a group ID to only show views assigned to that specific group.
group_id.title: Group Id

include.description: Sideload related data to include in the response. See Zendesk documentation for available sideloads.
include.human_parameter_description: Add extra related information to the results, such as permissions or other view-related data.
include.title: Include

page.description: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: traditional uses `?page=2` (integer page number); cursor uses `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). Mutually exclusive.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page. Maximum is 100 records per page for the views search endpoint.
per_page.title: Per Page

query.description: Query string used to find all views with matching title. Case-insensitive partial match on view titles.
query.human_parameter_description: Enter keywords to search for views by their title. The search matches partial titles case-insensitively.
query.title: Query

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by. Options: 'alphabetical' (sorts A-Z), 'created_at' (by creation date), 'updated_at' (by last modification), 'position' (by dashboard position). If unspecified, views are sorted by relevance to the query.
sort_by.human_parameter_description: Choose how to order the search results: alphabetically by title, by when they were created, by when they were last updated, or by their position on the views dashboard.
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.description: Sort order direction. Options: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'asc' for alphabetical and position sorts, 'desc' for created_at and updated_at sorts.
sort_order.human_parameter_description: Choose whether results appear in ascending order (A-Z, oldest first) or descending order (Z-A, newest first).
sort_order.title: Sort Order
